response.overview: Ghazal, a young man in his early twenties, struggles with the lasting effects of a traumatic experience during the war. After witnessing his closest friend being shot, he begins suffering from flashbacks, nightmares, and overwhelming reactions to sounds and sudden movements. Years later, Ghazal travels to Saudi Arabia to reconnect with old friends, hoping to find comfort and escape his painful memories. Instead, he finds himself feeling disconnected and unsafe, as the smallest triggers bring the past back to life. Haunted by memories he cannot leave behind, Ghazal must confront the wounds of his past and find a way to make peace with what happened
response.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
response.title: P.T.S.D
